sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, 'A Cup of Coffee' is an avoid and collect game, where you play as a flying cup of coffee, navigating through obstacles and collecting sugar to quench your thirst. The game's controls are simple and intuitive, allowing you to use mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to play. As you collect sugar, you'll earn points that can be spent in the shop to customize your cup's appearance. But be warned, the game is not just about collecting sugar - you'll also need to avoid obstacles like dirty cups and unwanted spills. If your cup gets dirty, you'll need to wash it away with some water to keep your coffee tasting its best.

One of the key mechanics of the game is the cup's health system. As you navigate through obstacles, your cup will accumulate dirt and grime, reducing its health. If your cup's health drops to zero, you'll lose a life. To avoid this, you'll need to wash your cup regularly with water, which will restore its health and keep it fresh. This mechanic adds a layer of strategy to the game, as you'll need to balance your sugar collection with your cup's health.

The game also features a variety of obstacles, each with its own unique challenges and rewards. Some obstacles may offer bonus sugar or points, while others may penalize you for landing on them. As you progress through the game, the obstacles will become increasingly difficult, requiring you to use your wits and reflexes to succeed.

Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of 'A Cup of Coffee' are simple yet engaging, providing a fun and challenging experience for players of all ages.
